scope: Source audit beyond the earlier successful single-interface DHCP exchange; requires fixes and negative packet tests

findings.problem: Uses struct capacity instead of received datagram length; reads option length without checking remaining byte and does not bound option data before returning.
Does not verify BOOTREPLY, Ethernet htype/hlen, cookie, chaddr, source port, exact server-id option length or ACK server identity before accepting a lease.
All sockets bind INADDR_ANY and use limited broadcast; no verified per-interface routing for multiple independent networks. /auto ignores per-adapter EnableDHCP selection.

prior_evidence_limit: Earlier successful single-interface exchange does not cover malformed replies or interface isolation.
